chapter: The Surface That Isn’t a Floor (first minute — stood / crust / apple / refuse landing)
carry: Teaspoon grammar: when VO names a thing, that thing is the picture.
Neutron star = compact GLOWING remnant (locked Parts 01/07). Never a grey moon, never Death Star greebles, never clay.
Physics-led, not gore. At most one Orbit+distant-remnant hang.
No cartoon mouths. One face, two arms, one centered underside glow. Exactly one Orbit.

plates.vo_idea: People ask: what if you stood on it?
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. SHIP GATE OPEN: a compact GLOWING NEUTRON STAR / remnant FILLS the frame — the surface that isn’t a floor. Photoreal celestial sphere, locked remnant look. ZERO Orbit, ZERO robot, ZERO title, ZERO brand sting. Intensity already present, will rise later. HARD FORBIDDEN: Orbit, any robot, grey moon, lunar craters, Death Star greebles, cracked-city plates, clay unfinished sphere, title card, logo. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Orbit BANKS INTO FRAME from the left and TRIES TO LAND on the compact glowing remnant — then thrusters ABORT, underside glow flaring as he pulls up. One action: land-attempt then abort. Not idle hover, not a wave, not blinks. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms, cream eyes with pupils, ONE centered underside glow not a rocket flame. HARD FORBIDDEN: grey moon, Death Star greebles, clay, two Orbits, cartoon mouth, landing legs, twin thrusters. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Not because the crust isn’t real — it is, in the sense physicists mean: a rigid outer layer.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. Close photoreal compact NEUTRON STAR — a glowing celestial sphere with a rigid outer crust, slow rotation. Natural star, not a grey moon. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: grey moon, lunar craters, Death Star greebles, honeycomb panels, clay unfinished sphere, Orbit. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: There may even be mountains so shallow they’d shame a sand grain, yet massive enough to ripple spacetime for gravitational-wave hunters.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. MACRO on a photoreal compact neutron star: centimetre-scale ripples so shallow they shame a sand grain, then spacetime itself RIPPLES for gravitational-wave hunters. Glowing star, not lunar mountains, not grey peaks. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: grey moon, Death Star greebles, clay, huge Earth mountains, Orbit. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: You don’t stand because your body cannot be a rigid object under that weight.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Orbit BRACES and loses rigidity — tipping, straining, a body that cannot stay a rigid object near the glowing remnant. Physics-led, not horror. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms. HARD FORBIDDEN: cartoon mouth, two Orbits, grey moon, Death Star greebles, flame jet. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Bones, steel, diamond — all of them are suggestions.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Orbit holds then loses fragments of STEEL and DIAMOND that fail as suggestions — materials crumpling as physics, not horror. Named materials are the picture. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms. HARD FORBIDDEN: cartoon mouth, two Orbits, grey moon, flame jet. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: An apple wouldn’t fall. An apple would become a rumour.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. GOLD BEAT: a photoreal red APPLE in vacuum beside a compact glowing neutron star. The apple does NOT fall. It smears into a rumour — physics, not horror. The APPLE is the subject. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: grey moon, Death Star greebles, Orbit, cartoon fruit icon. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Orbit’s underside glow flares as thrusters refuse the landing. A surface can exist without being a place for visitors.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. GOLD BEAT, INTENSITY RISING: Orbit’s single centered BOTTOM underside glow FLARES as he REFUSES the landing, then banks away. The compact glowing remnant is MORE DANGEROUS than the open — flaring, shearing, a surface with no visitors. Hover-pad glow, not a rocket flame, not landing legs. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms. HARD FORBIDDEN: twin thrusters, flame jet, landing legs, grey moon, Death Star greebles, two Orbits, cartoon mouth. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.
